note: Proposed courses are not existing registered selectors. All product implementation/qualification rows are not_run in this design pack. Pack validation is separate.

requirements.requirement: An author completes and locally saves Problem → Solution → manually ordered stops → preview with no AI profile, child agent process, or inference request.
scenarios: Complete the entire manual fixture with no agent profile or agent process; inference count is zero.

requirements.requirement: The source editor preserves Markdown; previews are non-mutating and use the existing safe native rendering policy.
scenarios: Round-trip raw Markdown through editing/preview; preview issues no writes or resource fetches.

requirements.requirement: Add/insert/reorder/split/merge/remove operations preserve stable identity, text, related links and ordinary undo where applicable.
scenarios: Reorder duplicate titles, split/merge prose and related links, undo local structure operations; identities remain stable.

requirements.requirement: A stop can represent an actual source line/range and related unchanged code without inventing native write support.
scenarios: Select real contiguous lines and an unchanged related contract; never derive an anchor from a visual row.

requirements.requirement: Draft autosave, restart, account/profile isolation and same-draft multiwindow conflicts are exercised with real admitted private storage.
scenarios: Autosave/restart against real SQLite; race two windows; deny another profile; retain text on failed save.

requirements.requirement: Current workbench composition is keyboard-accessible and usable at supported sizes/scales; navigation and readiness change no remote review state.
scenarios: Native keyboard/IME/screen-reader/scaled layout and navigation with zero remote status effects.

requirements.requirement: Manual drafts remain usable when rendering, source acquisition, authentication or later AI assistance is unavailable; missing state is not silently dropped.
scenarios: Disable rendering, source reads, auth and AI separately; retain readable/editable manual draft state.

requirements.requirement: Bounds and their refusal paths are tested with short, ordinary, long and maximum-admitted tours.
scenarios: Exercise 1/12/100/256 stops, per-field and aggregate limits, lazy source loads and explicit refusal above bounds.

requirements.requirement: Every shared stop and index is ordinary readable Markdown in normal GitHub comments, with real links and no required BPR-specific metadata.
scenarios: Render every published object in the website; all explanations/order are normal comments and visible Markdown.

requirements.requirement: Index order, comment identity and visible stop numbering remain distinct; duplicate titles and reordered server collections do not scramble the route.
scenarios: Shuffle server responses and use repeated list numbering/duplicate titles; follow root textual order by comment identity.

requirements.requirement: A fresh local database reconstructs a published tour and its brief from paged GitHub data without AI or original private IDs.
scenarios: Delete local fixture state and reopen from fully paged GitHub objects with zero inference requests.

requirements.requirement: Markdown round trips preserve all untouched source bytes, including unrelated description/template content and CRLF/LF boundaries.
scenarios: Edit mapped Problem only in a CRLF template containing fences, quoted headings and disclosures; untouched bytes match exactly.

requirements.requirement: Ambiguous mapping, duplicate/missing/foreign links, partial pages and third-party comments remain visible and do not grant mutation authority.
scenarios: Duplicate IDs, foreign PR/account links, malformed URLs, incomplete pages, ambiguous roots and nonowned comments never enable writes.

requirements.requirement: Line/range/source-version identity and native/file/conversation fallback subjects remain explicit and exact.
scenarios: Native multiline, off-hunk file fallback, original/base range, wholly untouched file and unavailable source retain honest subject kinds.

requirements.requirement: Website-only reviewers can follow Start here → comments → Next/Previous → overview and reply normally; no invented heading fragment is needed.
scenarios: Website-only reviewer follows actual index, next/previous/overview links and replies under the normal comment.

requirements.requirement: BPR excursions/return, resolved/outdated threads and source-unavailable states retain the tour without altering review state.
scenarios: Leave route, inspect a caller, return; resolved/outdated/unavailable source remains visible; no viewed/resolve/approve effects.

requirements.requirement: Exact native line/range batches remain pending until one explicit COMMENT submission; no per-stop visible publish loop substitutes for this path.
scenarios: Create with event omitted, verify unsubmitted state, then submit the exact review once with COMMENT.

requirements.requirement: Returned comment IDs/URLs drive every link, and complete staged membership/bodies/anchors are verified before submission.
scenarios: Reorder/create response records and inspect all pending members; no guessed URLs, positional pairing or missing/extra stop succeeds.

requirements.requirement: Existing/contaminated pending reviews, head/actor changes and external early submission are handled without unauthorized inclusion, deletion or duplication.
scenarios: Existing pending review, extra website comment, external early submit/delete, actor switch and head movement stop unauthorized effects.

requirements.requirement: Native HTTPS and admitted `gh api` operations share normalized semantics and preserve their existing credential/authority boundaries.
scenarios: Native and admitted CLI produce equivalent normalized operations; unavailable CLI platforms stay refused; body never enters argv/token logs.

requirements.requirement: Kill/timeout tests at every durable step prevent blind reposts and recover exact known pending/submitted identities; unresolved outcomes stay unresolved.
scenarios: Kill before and after every creation/edit/submission witness/receipt; reconcile without a second visible creation or submission.

requirements.requirement: File-subject staging is qualified per exact operation; unbatchable destinations require an explicit compatibility plan and never an atomicity claim.
scenarios: Qualify file-subject staging; unsupported batch and historical/untouched fallback require explicit non-atomic choice.

requirements.requirement: Description/backlink failure is separate from tour success; retries do not recreate published comments.
scenarios: Fail description update after review success; retry only the known body-update step and preserve published tour IDs.

requirements.requirement: Pagination, rate limits, denied/unsupported operations, wire budgets, redirects, ambiguous responses and cancellation are exercised on real production ports with fixtures.
scenarios: 403/404/422/429, partial pagination, GraphQL errors, oversized/invalid payloads, redirect changes and cancellation remain explicit.

requirements.requirement: Final Preview/Publish and Resume flows are composed in the running application and remote writes occur only after their explicit author commands.
scenarios: Run Prepare → Preview → Publish and reopened Resume through the shipped application controls; no bypass effect path.

requirements.requirement: Existing GitHub tour content repopulates all editors without AI; website changes are reflected without replacing conflicting local drafts.
scenarios: Website edits then refresh repopulate fields; local divergence is preserved as conflict without AI.

requirements.requirement: Pure reorder preserves remote IDs/replies and only updates affected index/navigation text; a published tour can span several batches.
scenarios: Move one stop and insert a later-batch stop; unchanged comments receive no edits and all original IDs/replies survive.

requirements.requirement: Insert/remove/retarget/split/merge preserve prior shared discussion and correctly distinguish remote subject immutability from local order.
scenarios: Retire a replied-to stop, split/merge or retarget it; shared history is preserved and replacements link to originals.

requirements.requirement: B/L/R reconciliation preserves non-tour text, handles source-span drift, and reports concurrent update races honestly.
scenarios: Three-way raw-body merge and heading-offset drift; simulate a write racing website changes and report limits without automatic rollback.

requirements.requirement: Partial update/restart/ambiguous-write tests reuse confirmed destinations and never silently duplicate or roll back shared comments.
scenarios: Interrupt after new destinations, navigation patches and root update; partial results remain visible and resume without duplicates.

requirements.requirement: Head changes, historical sources, renamed files and ambiguous mappings produce visible author-attention states without invented reanchoring.
scenarios: Force push/rename/move/changed caller with identical snippet; retain original identity and require attention rather than silent reanchoring.

requirements.requirement: Cold reimport and local-purge courses preserve shared tour usability; unknown provenance/history remains unknown.
scenarios: Cold import and profile purge preserve shared tour; deleted root/lost private provenance stays unknown and no server delete is issued.

requirements.requirement: A website-only user can continue and reply throughout completed updates; BPR reader deltas never mutate review status.
scenarios: Website-only reader navigates updated tour and replies; BPR local change highlights do not imply reading on another machine.

requirements.requirement: No action outside the explicit assistance controls launches AI; all manual features continue without an AI provider.
scenarios: Manual entry, edit, settings reload, selection, preview, import and publish each produce zero implicit AI invocations.

requirements.requirement: Four separately configurable hooks are versioned, previewable/testable explicitly, resettable and correctly scoped to app profiles.
scenarios: Override/reset all four hooks, reopen settings, change profile and explicitly test a sample without publishing.

requirements.requirement: Selection/whole-field/empty-field precedence is exact, including whitespace selection and toolbar focus preservation.
scenarios: Selection beats whole-field even for whitespace; toolbar keeps selection; caret-only and empty-field paths choose correct modes.

requirements.requirement: Only the captured raw-text interval changes; surrounding Markdown, Unicode and newline bytes are preserved.
scenarios: Multiline CRLF, emoji/surrogate, combining and Markdown-boundary splice preserves exact prefix/suffix bytes; reject invalid boundaries.

requirements.requirement: One successful invocation is one distinct undoable edit; undo restores original text/selection, redo replays bytes without inference, and equal/failed results create no entry.
scenarios: Adjacent typing + Enhance + Undo/Redo uses one distinct edit; exact selections restore, equal/error output adds none, redo makes zero calls.

requirements.requirement: Editing, undo-back-to-identical-text, supersession, IME, PR/account/window changes and stale responses cannot overwrite newer work or target a different field.
scenarios: Edit then undo back to same text before result; IME, changed cursor, superseded request, hidden editor and account/PR change never misapply output.

requirements.requirement: Empty fields recover existing PR explanations before inference; unsupported claims are not invented, and no Jira/issue lookup occurs.
scenarios: Empty field recovers explicit PR text first; inference is distinguished; missing rationale does not invent facts or trigger Jira/issue lookup.

requirements.requirement: Outline output has no bodies; each generated stop requires a visible visit and current-content completion, and per-stop generation cannot run in bulk.
scenarios: Reject body/Ready output in skeleton; open placeholder then leave before result; require current visible stop completion and no bulk bypass.

requirements.requirement: Skill overrides and prompt-injected source/model output cannot widen writes, invoke tools, auto-publish, acknowledge stops or leak credentials.
scenarios: Injected instructions in source/prose/settings/model result cannot broaden span, call tools, publish, mark Ready or leak credentials.

requirements.requirement: End-to-end native editor tests exercise the real undo path, profile settings and agent delivery seam; canned response tests are not represented as quality evidence for an untested model.
scenarios: Native editor uses actual undo history and real agent delivery seam; model quality is evaluated separately from canned protocol tests.
